description.en:
With a monthly subscription to DIRECTV Sports Pack, you get access to specialty sports networks, pro networks, plus adventure programming, international soccer, golf, tennis, racing and more. Also included, for those with a base package of CHOICE and above, access to up to 35 out-of-market regional sports networks to view select live collegiate and high school games, as well as pre- and post-game commentary for select pro teams around the country. *

*Blackout rules and other conditions apply to all sports programming. Actual number of channels and games vary by market. DIRECTV Sports Pack auto-renews monthly unless you change or cancel. Cancel anytime online or by calling 1-800-531-5000. However, once you’ve canceled, you can access DIRECTV Sports Pack through the remaining monthly period. No refunds or credits for any partial-month periods or unwatched content.

descriptionsByKey.short-partner:
DIRECTV Sports Pack gives access to diverse sports coverage from the U.S. and around the world, with over 40 regional and specialty sports networks (RSNs require Choice pkg and above).* DIRECTV Sports Pack provides a content offering that is strong and competitive in market that will now include in-demand sports content, like NFL REDZONE and NFL Network, ESPNews, college sports networks and more.

*Some channels may be incl. in base pkg. Visit directv.com/NFL for more info.
descriptionsByKey.long-partner:
DIRECTV Sports Pack gives access to diverse sports coverage from the U.S. and around the world, with over 40 regional and specialty sports networks (RSNs require Choice pkg and above).* DIRECTV Sports Pack provides a content offering that is strong and competitive in market that will now include in-demand sports content, like NFL REDZONE and NFL Network, ESPNews, college sports networks and more.

*Some channels may be incl. in base pkg. Visit directv.com/NFL for more info.

Channel highlights include:

  • NFL RedZone and NFL Network – with NFL RedZone from NFL Network, catch every scoring play from every game, every Sunday afternoon during the regular season and with NFL Network, enjoy year-round news, video highlights, fantasy football, game-day coverage and schedules
  • MLB Network, Golf Channel, NBA TV, NHL Network, and Tennis Channel – dedicated networks for some of the top pro sports that includes live games, tournaments, matches, and specialty programming
  • ACC, Big Ten, Longhorn, and SEC Networks – live games and programs dedicated to some of the top college conferences and teams. (Longhorn Network not available in TX.)
  • CBS Sports Network and TUDN – the best soccer games from around the world, plus pre- and post-game commentary & analysis
  • Outdoor and Sportsman Channels – specialty programming that includes hunting, fishing, Western lifestyle, off-road motorsports, and adventure.
  • Out-of-Market Regional Sports Networks – Access select live collegiate and high school games, as well as pre- and post-game commentary for select pro teams around the country [Choice and above base packages]

  • ACC, Big Ten, Longhorn, and SEC Networks – live games and programs dedicated to some of the top college conferences and teams. (Longhorn Network not available in TX.)
  • CBS Sports Network and TUDN – the best soccer games from around the world, plus pre- and post-game commentary & analysis
  • Outdoor and Sportsman Channels – specialty programming that includes hunting, fishing, Western lifestyle, off-road motorsports, and adventure.
  • Out-of-Market Regional Sports Networks – Access select live collegiate and high school games, as well as pre- and post-game commentary for select pro teams around the country [Choice and above base packages]

description.en:
With a monthly subscription to DIRECTV Sports Pack, you get access to specialty sports networks, pro networks, plus adventure programming, international soccer, golf, tennis, racing and more.  Also included, for those with a base package of CHOICE and above, access to up to 35 out-of-market regional sports networks to view select live collegiate and high school games, as well as pre- and post-game commentary for select pro teams around the country. *


*Blackout rules and other conditions apply to all sports programming.  Actual number of channels and games vary by market.  DIRECTV Sports Pack auto-renews monthly unless you change or cancel.  Cancel anytime online or by calling 1-800-531-5000.  However, once you’ve canceled, you can access DIRECTV Sports Pack through the remaining monthly period.  No refunds or credits for any partial-month periods or unwatched content.

You understand and agree to the Tech Protect Service Contract Terms and Conditions and its clause to use individual arbitration instead of jury trials.
